About.title: About Party Game
About.description: Party Game is a free mobile mini-game web app for groups. No app install needed — just open it in your browser and pass the phone around. Perfect for parties, bars, and hangouts.
About.sharkDesc: 20 teeth, some rotten — press them one by one and hope for the best. Hit a rotten tooth and you get the penalty!
About.sharkHow: Set penalty count (1–5) → Press teeth one by one → Hit a rotten one and pay!
About.cardDesc: Cards are shuffled face-down and each player picks one. Whoever draws the skull diamond gets the penalty!
About.cardHow: Enter player count → Memorize skull position → Cards shuffle → Pick a card → Skull = penalty!
About.tensionDesc: Hold the button to fill the cup. Let go just before it overflows — but nobody knows exactly when that is!
About.tensionHow: Hold the button → Watch the cup fill → Release before overflow → Spill it and pay!
About.tip: No app install required — runs instantly in any mobile browser. One player opens the game, then pass the phone around. All games are completely free.
About.contact: For inquiries, please reach us by email.

SharkHowTo.title: How to Play
SharkHowTo.prepBody: 2+ players, 1 smartphone. Before starting, choose the number of rotten teeth (1–5). More rotten teeth = more tension!
SharkHowTo.playBody: Players take turns pressing one tooth at a time. Safe teeth turn dark when pressed. The moment you hit a rotten tooth, the screen flashes red and the penalty screen appears.
SharkHowTo.penaltyBody: The player who hits the rotten tooth performs the pre-agreed penalty. Press Play Again to start a new game.
SharkHowTo.tipBody: Rotten tooth positions are randomized every game. Remembering last game's result won't help!

CardHowTo.title: How to Play
CardHowTo.prepBody: 2–8 players, 1 smartphone. Enter the number of players and that many cards will be dealt.
CardHowTo.playBody: At the start, the skull card is briefly revealed — memorize its position! Then the cards are shuffled randomly. Players take turns picking a card one by one.
CardHowTo.penaltyBody: The player who picks the skull diamond gets the penalty.
CardHowTo.tipBody: Track the skull card with your eyes during the shuffle — that's the key strategy. Distracting other players is fair game too!

TensionHowTo.title: How to Play
TensionHowTo.prepBody: 1+ players, 1 smartphone. Players take turns challenging one at a time.
TensionHowTo.playBody: Hold the button to fill the cup with liquid. Release before it overflows to stay safe! The next player continues from where you left off.
TensionHowTo.penaltyBody: The player whose hold causes the cup to overflow gets the penalty. Since each player adds to the same cup, the later you go, the more dangerous it gets.
TensionHowTo.tipBody: The overflow point is randomized every game. It might look almost full but still be safe — or it might overflow way earlier than expected. Nobody knows!
